review.reason: Spirit-board puzzle: the player spells the phrase out letter by letter. 'ASHESTOASHES' is 12 letters; 'CENDRESAUXCENDRES' would be 17. Until the board's capacity is checked in game, both stay English.

Riddle and ingredient lists must be translated as one unit: the riddle has to keep pointing at exactly the same six items and stay unambiguous against the twelve distractors. Verify in game that all six are still identifiable.
